title:
Learning should not stop
when the lights go out
body:
ASTAR
Autonomous Solar Tutoring and Resource System
notes: Open with the mission. ASTAR is an offline-first learning initiative. The software exists as a local prototype, while the solar device is proposed.

title: Learning needs a dependable fallback
body:
When power, connectivity or access to schools is interrupted, students can lose access to digital lessons.

ASTAR is designed to keep structured learning materials within reach.
notes: Explain the design problem without quoting unverified statistics. ASTAR complements teachers and schools. It does not claim to replace them.

title: Three parts, one learning experience
body:
ASTAR device
Proposed solar-powered educational hardware

ASTAR software
Offline lessons, practice and local progress

ASTAR Forge
Content preparation, review and export
notes: Forge is the proposed name for the content-preparation role fulfilled by the current textbook studio. Hardware integration is future work.

title: Choose a lesson. Keep learning.
body:
Numbered chapters and lessons
Monochrome reading and diagrams
Local completion and resume state
notes: Existing saved software screenshot from the workspace test-results folder. Demonstrate the current reader rather than describing a future interface.

title: Preserve the detail that learning needs
body:
Textbook reading with diagrams
Page references and original prompts
Teacher-authored interactive practice
notes: Existing mathematics-reader screenshot. Complex notation is preserved as image regions. Original textbook MCQs are not reliably parsed into interactive options. Long answers are written on paper.

title: Prepare content with review built in
body:
Import a textbook PDF
Inspect flagged conversion issues
Export a standalone offline reader
notes: Existing saved textbook-studio screenshot. Conversion uses heuristics. Automatic checks are not a guarantee of educational accuracy. Human content review remains necessary.

title: The solar device is the next step
body:
E-paper display and physical controls
Local lessons and storage
Solar charging with battery storage

Next: validate components, power use and firmware
notes: The device illustration is a concept, not a photograph or manufacturing specification. Battery runtime, controller selection, dimensions and costs are not validated.

title: Start with an education partner
body:
Intended learners
Students aged 10-18 in disrupted and underserved settings

Proposed route
Partner-led pilot, facilitator support and local content review
notes: Education NGOs and humanitarian organisations are prospective deployment partners. No partnership, signed procurement or field deployment is claimed.

title: An institutional model to validate
body:
INR 3,700
Founder target unit cost

INR 4,700
Founder target institutional selling price
notes: Targets copied from supplied ASTAR.pdf, not supplier quotes. The implied INR 1,000 difference must cover costs not yet established. Validate battery, charging, testing, shipping, tax, support and content costs before claiming a margin.

title: Make the next milestone measurable
body:
1  Validate the hardware energy budget
2  Review a small curriculum package
3  Test reading and navigation with learners
4  Refine cost and partner-led pilot design
notes: Measure task completion, reading usability, content errors and device energy use. These are proposed tests. No learning-outcome improvement or field results are claimed.

title: Help us make learning more resilient
body:

notes: Close with a focused invitation to technical mentors and organisations who can help design a responsible pilot. Mission: access to learning should not depend on access to infrastructure.
